content.title: About
content.content: Heart is a dietary supplement designed to support cardiovascular health. The formula combines vitamins, minerals, and plant extracts known for their beneficial effects on heart function and blood vessels.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend includes coenzyme Q10, which plays a key role in cellular energy production in the heart.
Olive leaf extract helps reduce oxidative stress.
Vitamin B6 and magnesium contribute to maintaining a normal heart rhythm.
The product is free from gluten, lactose, and artificial colourings.
Each package is formulated for a 30‑day daily regimen.

items.title: Supports energy metabolism
items.content: Coenzyme Q10 enhances ATP production in cardiomyocytes, boosting heart endurance.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Olive extract and vitamin E neutralise free radicals, reducing vascular damage.

items.title: Blood pressure regulation
items.content: Magnesium and potassium promote relaxation of vascular smooth muscle, helping maintain normal pressure.

items.title: Cholesterol reduction
items.content: Plant sterols in the formula help lower intestinal cholesterol absorption.

items.title: Nervous system support for heart rhythm
items.content: Vitamin B6 aids in the synthesis of neurotransmitters that influence cardiac rhythm.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: The supplement contains plant extracts that may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Coenzyme Q10 can potentiate the effects of anticoagulants; consult a healthcare professional if you are on such medication.

items.title: Excessive dosage
items.content: High doses of magnesium may cause diarrhea and gastrointestinal discomfort.

items.title: Pregnancy and lactation
items.content: Safety during pregnancy and breastfeeding has not been established; it is advisable to avoid use.

content.title: How to Take
content.content: Take one capsule (or tablet) daily with a meal, accompanied by plenty of water. Do not exceed the recommended dose without medical advice.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. Do not store above 30 °C. Shelf life is indicated on the packaging.
